title: PIMPINESE (An Old School Party)
venue: Inn on the Lake, Bond Avenue
description:
Step back in time at PIMPINESE (An Old School Party). Join The PM, DJ Rexy, MC Pacman and DJ Kudjo for Borga Highlife, Hiplife, '80s Funk, '90s R&B and old school Afrobeats. Nostalgia galore.

Saturday 28 November 2026, 9PM–3AM at Inn on the Lake, Bond Avenue, Milton Keynes, MK1 1PA.

Free entry before 10:30pm. £10 after.
